pages.title: Hope Bloom
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplies to: §r Sword of the Free Will, Sword of the Free Will · Eternal Spark$(br2)§lEffect: §r While health is below 50%, melee damage is increased by 50% and Resistance II is granted continuously.$(br2)§lInstant-Kill Immunity: §r Blocks one instance of instant-kill damage; 15-minute cooldown.$(br2)§lObtaining: §r Enchanting Table, loot chests, villager trades.$(br2)Only works on the Sword of the Free Will line.
